Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.overview: Bernardo Faria's positional escapes for older grapplers, three volumes: getting out of side control, mount, knee on belly and the back without relying on speed, flexibility or explosive movement. The emphasis is on frames, timing and getting back to half guard or closed guard. The publisher listing has no per-volume breakdown.
Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.for: Older or less athletic gi players.
key: Low-energy side control and mount escapes

Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.overview: Bernardo Faria's submission escapes for older grapplers, four volumes organised by the position you're stuck in: escaping submissions while passing (getting caught in guard), from bottom mount, from bottom side control, and from bottom knee on belly. The focus is on early, safe defence that protects older joints.
Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.for: Older gi players who want to tap less without risky escapes.
